text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder got injured during<n>training, so I take
her to the infirmary<n>for treatment.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
choice_data_list: It's my fault for not paying closer attention.
Get some rest for now—there's always tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
choice_data_list: It's my fault for not paying closer attention.
Get some rest for now—there's always tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer! This wasn't your fault in any<n>way.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The blame lies with me. I was too<n>caught up in the
moment and lost<n>track of my surroundings.
choice_data_list: Then we can both be more careful next time.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I am an Umamusume, and you are my<n>trainer. We
must compensate for one<n>another's weaknesses.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I keep a sharp lookout for Grass<n>Wonder's safety
from there on out.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Very well. The fault is mine in the first<n>place.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'll play it safe for today.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder returns to her room<n>once the
treatment is complete.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I understand. I do worry that I might<n>grow restless
not being able to run...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But I can endure today so long as I<n>know it's for a
better tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'll restore my energy for now so I<n>won't miss a
step once treatment is<n>over.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But in return... I ask that you come up<n>with lots of
new training ideas in the<n>meantime. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder's recovery takes a<n>while, but once
she gets back on the<n>track, she shows more
motivation to<n>train than before.
